mostWorthwhile.text: The lymph-node sequence was most worthwhile: the messenger activated helper T cells, which then helped the matching B cell multiply into antibody-producing and memory cells. It connected the different cells' roles in a way I could follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed direct interactions were initially confusing because the B cell displayed a fragment but could not yet interact with the helper cells. Later results explained the missing activation step, though the initial feedback did not say why.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the dendritic cell had to activate helper T cells before they could help the B cell. The linked airway-to-node description also clarified the messenger's journey.

arbitrary.text: Using the lymph node to start the messenger-cell interaction initially felt somewhat arbitrary: I inferred the route from compatibility feedback rather than from a clear explanation of why the direct pair failed. The result then showed the cell travelling to the node.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: seeing separate cellular interactions build toward antibody marking and immune memory held my interest, though I would want similarly clear explanations of where interactions happen.
